title: The Excellent harvest that autumn
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：excellent　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 excellent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the cook wrote of ① an excellent harvest that autumn in the menu, and everybody in the canteen said at once that it was ② more excellent than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the cook, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the excellent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most excellent harvest that autumn anybody in the canteen had ever seen, or so the menu for September 1968 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too excellent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the guest who had come to help; the excellent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an excellent answer in the exam, and said that no guest in his right mind would call it ⑥ as excellent as the answer in the exam they had once had in the old canteen. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was excellent or not, and he said so.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the menu. What the line asked for was ⑦ something excellent, and nothing besides. The guest from the next canteen called the whole plan ⑧ quite excellent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the menu kept the names of the excellent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984, for the whole place, she wrote of another excellent harvest that autumn in the same menu, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ more excellent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most excellent answer in the exam in the whole canteen, she said in 1986, was the one she could never quite name; the excellent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 优秀（前置定语 an excellent harvest that autumn：1974 年厨子在菜单里记下的那件优秀的收成）
B. adj. 优秀／极好（比较级 more excellent than：文中两处，一处比那年秋天的收成，一处比预想）
C. adj. 优秀／极好（最高级 the most excellent：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 优秀（表语 too excellent to do：母亲觉得它太优秀，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 极好（前置定语 an excellent answer in the exam：叔叔把整件事称作一桩极好的出色作答）
F. adj. 极好（同级比较 as excellent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩考卷上的出色作答相比）
G. adj. 极好（后置定语 something excellent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 极好（受程度副词修饰 quite excellent：那位客人的评价）

items.q: the most excellent harvest that autumn anybody
an excellent answer in the exam
The most excellent answer in the exam in

answers.why: excellent 意为“优秀”，1974 年厨子在菜单里记下的是“一件优秀的收成”，此处作前置定语 an excellent harvest that autumn。
excellent 意为“优秀”，此处用比较级 more excellent than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
excellent 意为“优秀”，菜单上 九月 那行字说它是食堂里最优秀的一件，故用最高级 the most excellent harvest that autumn。
excellent 意为“优秀”，母亲认为这件东西“太优秀了，谁也用不上”，too excellent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
excellent 意为“极好”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩极好的出色作答”，此处作前置定语 an excellent answer in the exam。
excellent 意为“极好”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩考卷上的出色作答一样极好”，同级比较用 as excellent as。
excellent 意为“极好”，菜单上那半行字要的是“极好的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something excellent。
excellent 意为“极好”，邻食堂来的那位客人认为这套计划“相当极好”，quite 修饰原级 excellent。
excellent 意为“极好”，1984 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要极好”，故用比较级 more excellent than。
excellent 意为“极好”，母亲 1986 年说的是“整个食堂里最极好的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most excellent answer in the exam。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，厨子在菜单里记下了一件优秀的收成。（an excellent harvest that autumn）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更优秀。（more excellent than …）
母亲觉得它太优秀，谁也用不上。（too excellent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩极好的出色作答。（an excellent answer in the exam）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩考卷上的出色作答一样极好。（as excellent as …）
到了 1981 年，菜单上只剩半行字：要的是一件极好的东西。（something excellent）
answers: In 1974 the cook wrote of an excellent harvest that autumn in the menu.
Everybody said it was more excellent than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too excellent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an excellent answer in the exam.
He said nobody would call it as excellent as the answer in the exam they had once had.
By 1981 the menu asked for nothing but something excellent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 excellent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the cook wrote of an excellent harvest that autumn in the menu, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most excellent harvest that autumn in the canteen, or so the menu says.
My mother thought it too excellent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an excellent answer in the exam, and nobody argued with him.
The guest from the next canteen called the plan quite excellent, and everybody laughed.
The excellent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
